subject.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core

question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this action-ledger v1 schema, identity model, privacy boundary, shard/import format, and CrabFleet projection contract as the permanent foundation for future workflow instrumentation?
rationale: The patch can be technically correct while still committing the project to durable product, compatibility, privacy, retention, and operational semantics that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve v1 and merge core
options.body: Accept the complete durable contract, merge this isolated core, and review https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/512 separately for safe dual-write integration.

options.title: Request contract revisions
options.body: Keep the stack paused and specify the schema, privacy, retention, import, or projection guarantees that must change before writers adopt it.

options.title: Defer immutable history
options.body: Pause or close the stack if the operational storage and long-term compatibility commitments are not currently sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve v1 and merge core
recommendation.body: Accept the complete durable contract, merge this isolated core, and review https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/512 separately for safe dual-write integration.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest available final-decision candidate because he merged the adjacent proof architecture and directly connected it to this PR.
